=== stderr
lagent v0.0.0-characterize — scripted-main
instructions: AGENTS.md
sandbox: DISABLED — shell commands run unconfined; restart with the sandbox enabled to confine them
/help for commands, Ctrl+D to quit

> 
> commands:
  /help      show this help
  /tools     list tools and each one's current approval gate
  /mcp       list connected MCP servers with their loaded state (/mcp load <server> advertises one, /mcp reload reconnects)
  /auto      auto-approve: on|off, or bare to toggle (shift+tab too)
  /readonly  read-only: on|off · bare shows the state
  /add-dir <path>   add a directory outside the project, written like the project (this process only)
  /read-dir <path>  add a directory outside the project, read only (this process only)
  /dirs      list the project, the work directory and the added directories
  /settings  view and edit settings, with provenance
  /skills    list installed skills
  /skill <name> [args]   invoke a skill directly
  /memory    list memories (facts recalled in every session)
  /remember [global] <name> <fact>   save a memory (project scope unless global)
  /forget [global] <name>            remove a memory
  /show <path>   draw an image in this terminal (the model uses show_image for the same thing)
  /usage     token statement for this session
  /version   version and platform
  /compact   summarise the older part of the conversation
  /clear     reset the conversation
  /quit      exit (/exit and Ctrl+D too)

attach:
  @<path>      a project file or directory (Tab completes)
  @<image>     images may also use absolute or ~ paths (@~/Desktop/shot.png)
  @clipboard   the clipboard image

shell:
  !<command>   run directly — sandboxed, no approval, output shared with the model

keys:
  Enter send · up/down history · Ctrl+C interrupt/clear · Ctrl+D quit
  Ctrl+J or a trailing \ inserts a newline; a multi-line paste stays one message
  typing during a turn queues the text (! and / cannot be queued)
  approval dialog: arrows/Tab select · Enter confirm · y/n/N/a/p direct (N = deny with a reason)

> main loop (scripted-main):
  rounds 1 · prompt 100 · output 10 · thoughts 0
  cached 0 of prompt (0%)
  context now 100 of 32.8k window (0%)

>   demo                     [project] A demonstration skill.
invoke with /skill <name> [arguments]; the model can also load them itself when the task matches

>   list_files   List directory entries inside the project. (read-only)
  list_tree    List the project as an indented tree (directories end with /), recursively from an optional subdirectory. (read-only)
  search_files Fast text search across project files (pure grep, no index). (read-only)
  read_file    Read a file inside the project and return its content. (read-only)
  file_info    Report what a file IS without reading it into context: content-judged type (the `file` command's job — executables, archives, scripts, text/binary; the extension is shown but never trusted), size, mode, modified and created times, and MD5/SHA1/SHA256 hashes — the trio hash-lookup tools take. (read-only)
  view_image   Attach an image file from the project to the conversation as visual input (screenshots fetched by tools, extracted images, diagrams). (read-only)
  show_image   Show an image file to the OPERATOR, drawn in their terminal (a chart you generated, a screenshot you were asked about). (read-only)
  write_file   Create a new file inside the project with the given content, or deliberately replace an existing one whole. (requires approval)
  edit_file    Replace exact strings in a project file. (requires approval)
  shell_exec   Run a shell command (bash) with the project root as the working directory. (requires approval)
  request_directory Call this when a path the task needs is outside the project, whether the user named it or a tool refused it: it asks the user to add that directory to this session. (requires approval)
  load_skill   Load a skill installed by the user. (read-only)
  save_memory  Persist one short fact for future sessions: scope "global" is recalled in every project, scope "project" only in this one. (requires approval)
  delete_memory Remove one persisted memory that is stale or wrong. (requires approval)
  ask_user     Present a QUESTION and 2-8 short OPTIONS to the user and get their choice, without ending your turn. (read-only)
  mcp_load     Load one MCP server named in the runtime facts: its tools are added to your tool list for the rest of the session and listed in the result. (read-only)

> project: <PROJECT> (write)
work directory: <HOME>/.local/state/lagent/<PROJECT-ESCAPED>/work/<ID1> (write)
no added directories — /add-dir <path> or /read-dir <path> adds one

> lagent v0.0.0-characterize on macOS <OS> (darwin/arm64)

> mcp reloaded: 0 server(s), 0 tool(s)
history cleared — the next message starts a fresh conversation

> mcp reloaded: 0 server(s), 0 tool(s)

> 
> bye
session <ID2> — resume: lagent -c (or --resume <ID2>)
2 rounds · prompt 200 · output 20
